about_short_description.short_description: Cerafiltec specializes in providing environmental engineering services that include projection, plant layout design, and plant operation.

product.name: Ceramic Flat Sheet Membrane Technology
product.description: A filtration technology using ceramic flat sheet membranes for water and wastewater treatment, replacing polymeric membranes and improving filtration quality and durability.

identifier.value: Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) Upgrade and Polymeric UF Membrane Replacement

product.name: Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) Upgrade and Polymeric UF Membrane Replacement
product.description: Service to replace polymeric ultrafiltration membranes with ceramic membranes in MBR systems to reduce clogging and improve operational stability.

identifier.value: Sand Filter Rehabilitation with Prefabricated Ceramic Membrane Modules

product.name: Sand Filter Rehabilitation with Prefabricated Ceramic Membrane Modules
product.description: A solution to rehabilitate and increase capacity of existing sand filter systems using compact ceramic membrane modules installed inside existing tanks.

product.name: Active Cake Layer Filtration (ACLF) Process
product.description: A filtration process combining adsorption with ultrafiltration using ceramic membranes to remove dissolved organics, pathogens, microplastics, and toxins from water and wastewater.

identifier.value: Softening Filtration Process Using Ceramic Membranes

product.name: Softening Filtration Process Using Ceramic Membranes
product.description: A filtration process that removes total hardness and sulfate from water using ceramic membranes, replacing multi-step treatment systems and sand filters.

identifier.value: Produced Water Treatment with Ceramic Flat Sheet Membranes

product.name: Produced Water Treatment with Ceramic Flat Sheet Membranes
product.description: A filtration solution for produced water in oil and gas applications using ceramic membranes tolerant to high oil and grease content.
